description: dataPatch semantics (record.schema.json#/$defs/dataPatch). Apply `patch` to `before`: the result equals `after`, or the patch fails with `error` (the index of the failing operation and the reason) and the data does not change. With dataSchema, the result is also checked against that schema. Same $fill rule as record.json.

cases.name: set a numeric key in an object
append with keepLast drops from the front
keepLast larger than the length keeps all
remove an array item moves later items down
remove where with no match is not an error
remove where uses JSON number equality
remove where does not match a string to a number
all or nothing: a later failure keeps the old data
the result must still match the kind
a valid result for the kind
the result must stay under the size cap
